To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
PBDEs and PCBs are present in follicular fluid in Central China, with BDE-100, CB-28, and CB-52 as indicators of HOP congeners in follicicular fluid.
the concentrations of PBDE and PCB congeners in follicicular fluids from women undergoing IVF in Central China were higher than those in the serum of the general population.

persistent HOPs are present in follicular fluid from women in Central China, and that penta-BDE products and tetra-CB congeners are the major sources of PBDEs and PCBs in the follicular fluids, respectively.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the presence of PBDEs and PCBs in human follicular fluids and provides a baseline for future research on the relationship between these chemicals and reproductive health in China.
the presence and distribution of PBDEs and PCBs in follicular fluids, and provides a reference for further studies on the relationship between HOPs and female reproductive health.
the occurrence, congener profiles and possible sources of PBDEs and PCBs in human follicular fluids from Central China.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
HOPs in follicular fluids of patients undergoing in vitio fertilization in Central China were dominated by PBDEs and CBs.
PBDEs were the dominant HOPs in follicular fluids of women undergoing IVF, with the penta-BDE mixture being the principal source.
the PBDEs and PCBs in follicular fluids of patients undergoing IVF in Central China were at a low level, but were not negligible, which may have an adverse effect on the reproductively of women.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the concentrations of PBDEs and PCBs in human follicular fluids were significantly higher in Central China than in other countries.
the HOPs in human follicular fluids were mainly derived from the environment and that their concentrations in follicular fluids were not affected by the age of patients.
PBDEs are more likely than PCBs to be bioaccumulated in human follicular fluids.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the concentrations of PBDEs and PCBs in follicular fluids from Central China are higher than those reported previously in other countries, and the concentrations of BDE-100 and CB-52 in follicular fluid may be used as indicators of PBDE and PCB contamination, respectively.

the levels of HOPs in human follicular fluids in Central China are comparable to those in the United States and Europe, and that the sources and congener patterns of HOPs are different in follicular fluids of women from China.

the levels of PBDEs and PCBs in follicular fluids of women from China are relatively high, and the levels of PBDCs and PCBs are comparable to the concentrations of these pollutants reported in human milk, blood, and adipose tissue in China.
